overloads.semanticRole: SAVE SET saves set to document , a document on disk.

constraints: If document is an empty string, a Create File dialog box lets the user name the document.
Sets the OK system variable to 0 if the user cancels the save dialog or an error occurs, otherwise 1.
A set is a snapshot of a selection at save time and does not save field values; it can become inaccurate if underlying records are modified/deleted or the defining criteria changes.
